summary: Statistics Canada 1976 roster lists 1975 as the establishment year, not precise incorporation date.

Annual Transit Services Act administration report and T.S. Holdings consolidated audit tabled in Legislature. Find full tabled documents.
One common share listed in provincial investment schedule; 1979 comparator also one share.
Statistics Canada list explicitly marks subsidiary consolidated but does not specify parent or start date.

Separate corporation acquired Swan Valley plant/buildings/equipment/technology under a $1.5m debenture dated 15 April 1977.

Corporations Canada No. 026524-1 issued certificate of continuance from British Columbia to federal law; not a new incorporation.
Federal registry says Swan Valley Foods amalgamated into NABISCO BRANDS CANADA LTD.; verify resulting name-at-amalgamation chain separately.

$554 provision reported; do not interpret nil balance as disposal.
